_about: T678 (owner 2026-11-11): IS EACH CURATED TIDAL SPLIT DFO-WRITTEN? One row per `split` row of waters/tidal_limits.json (33): `dfo_written` true = DFO's own words name the boundary there (a sign, a bridge, a written line), quoted from the cached DFO copies under data/source/dfo_tidal_areas; false = not shown to be DFO's (kept, listed for the owner; the split is NOT dropped). Owner ruling: only DFO-written splits have authority over the tidal cut (rank 1); the rest fall to the coast crossing. `kind`: dfo_list (Area 29's "Tidal water boundaries in streams and rivers"), dfo_area_text (a DFO tidal-area description naming the boundary), dfo_subarea_bridge (a DFO tidal subarea bounded at a named bridge), dfo_freshwater (a DFO freshwater page naming the tidal boundary sign), dfo_guide (DFO's B.C. Sport Fishing Guide, Tidal Water Boundaries). A sidecar, not fields on tidal_limits.json: that file is rewritten from the marks and keeps only its own fields. Classified by Claude 2026-11-11; the owner may correct any row. No reader yet: the atlas build's tidal cut (T678 step 10) reads it.
